jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Smart Content AI
jobs.description: As the first MLE in the team you will lay the technical foundations for our ML stack, set coding and experimentation standards, and deliver high-impact models that power content discovery and personalisation across Canva. Build multimodal content-understanding pipelines that detect people, objects, styles and scenes, turning every asset into richly tagged, high-quality embeddings. Thrive in cross-functional teams and enjoy collaborating with engineers, UX designers, and PMs, with a product mindset.

jobs.title: Business Analysis & Business Intelligence Graduate Program
jobs.description: As an FDM Business Intelligence Consultant, you'll play a pivotal role in analysing and interpreting data to improve the operations and the performance of your company. The program starts with fully-funded training through the FDM Academy, led by expert trainers, to get you job-ready in 6-14 weeks, depending on the career pathway you choose from either the technical or business streams. After successfully completing your training, you'll have the technical and professional skills you need to step into an integral position with one or more of FDM's industry-leading, multinational clients in Australia during the two-year program. You'll collaborate closely with the IT team to develop strategies helping the business gain and maintain competitive advantage, and become an expert at using the latest technology or machine learning to gather crucial insights before communicating your analysis to high-level decision-makers. In 2022, FDM rose 5 places to #16 on the GradConnection Top 100 Graduate Employers and is one of GradAustralia's Top 100 Graduate Employers.

jobs.title: 2026 Graduate Program – Data Scientist
jobs.description: As a Graduate Data Scientist, you'll work on real-world projects that shape betting experiences and manage risk using tools like Python, Spark, R, and Databricks. You'll gain hands-on experience across the full data science lifecycle, from model design to deployment while exploring emerging technologies like AI. Supported by experienced mentors, you'll rotate through at least two teams, building technical and commercial skills that set the foundation for a successful data science career. Applicants should be final-year students or recent graduates within the past two years (2024, 2025 or January 2026) of a degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Science, or a related field. Along with a competitive salary and generous performance-based bonus, benefits include hack days, access to an Employee Assistance Program, career development programs, expert-led internal training, and weekly concierge service including free massages, facials and nail appointments onsite.

jobs.title: Intern – Data Engineer (Feb 2026)

jobs.title: Platform Engineer – AI & Cloud Capabilities
jobs.description: Sportsbet is looking for a Platform Engineer to join a high-performing platform team focused on evolving and scaling Sportsbet's cloud and AI capabilities. The role requires candidates qualified and experienced in Github, AWS, AI and automation, with a focus on keeping Sportsbet at the forefront of development best practices and the use of AI. Key responsibilities include: ensuring solutions perform at their optimum levels, helping engineers become self-sufficient in Github, and providing leading edge automation solutions for the wider engineering teams. Additional duties include staying abreast of the evolving security landscape, translating new security requirements into tooling patterns for engineers, and staying current with opportunities to enhance cloud offerings particularly in the API development space. As part of the global Flutter Group, Sportsbet is a major player internationally with a tight-knit team of 1,300+ teammates in Melbourne, Sydney and Darwin, with over half in Tech & Data Science.
